description: This file defines a CSVReader class for reading and processing CSV files within the Superset project, including encoding detection, chunked reading, and type casting with detailed error handling.

classes.name: CSVReaderOptions
classes.description: Options for configuring CSV reading, extending ReaderOptions with additional CSV-specific parameters.

classes.name: CSVReader
classes.description: Main class for reading CSV files, handling encoding detection, chunked reading, type casting, and error reporting.

methods.name: _detect_encoding
methods.description: Detects file encoding by sampling the file with multiple fallback encodings.

methods.name: _select_optimal_engine
methods.description: Selects the best CSV parsing engine ('c' or 'pyarrow') based on availability and pandas support.

methods.name: _find_invalid_values_numeric
methods.description: Identifies invalid numeric values in a DataFrame column.

methods.name: _find_invalid_values_non_numeric
methods.description: Identifies invalid non-numeric values in a DataFrame column based on target dtype.

methods.name: _get_error_details
methods.description: Generates detailed error messages for invalid values during type conversion, limiting output for readability.

methods.name: _create_error_message
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive error message including error details and counts.

methods.name: _cast_single_column
methods.description: Attempts to cast a DataFrame column to a specified type with detailed error handling.

methods.name: _cast_column_types
methods.description: Casts multiple DataFrame columns to specified types with error reporting.

methods.name: _split_types
methods.description: Splits column types into pandas-native and custom types for processing.

methods.name: _read_csv
methods.description: Reads a CSV file into a DataFrame with support for chunking, encoding detection, and type casting.

methods.name: file_to_dataframe
methods.description: Reads a FileStorage object into a pandas DataFrame, with optional chunking based on configuration.

methods.name: file_metadata
methods.description: Extracts metadata (column names) from a CSV file.
